title: Squiggly Scribble Squid
statement: Hovering among mossy stone arches and drifts of frosted sea-glass, this teacup-sized cephalopod ripples with shifting, hypnotic constellations whenever a curious visitor leans close. In bursts of sudden delight, it darts through the twilight water trailing luminous loops of golden ink that curl like cursive before gently dissolving.
